description: Java source code for ShareDividendApiResource class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing share dividend payouts in the Fineract platform.

classes.name: ShareDividendApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing share dividend payouts, including retrieval, creation, update, and deletion of dividend data.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all dividend payout records for a specific share product, with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: retrieveDividendDetails
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific dividend payout, including associated account data.

methods.name: createDividendDetail
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new share product dividend payout.

methods.name: updateDividendDetail
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update or approve a specific dividend payout based on command parameter.

methods.name: deleteDividendDetail
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a specific dividend payout record.
